chunks: Whoever restrains his sight, his tongue, and his hand during the Days of Tashrīq, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will record for him the like of a Hajj in the coming year.

key_terms.أَيَّامَ التَّشْرِيقِ: the Days of Tashrīq, the designated days following Eid al-Adha
key_terms.بَصَرَهُ: his sight; guarding what one looks at
key_terms.حَجٍّ: Hajj, the pilgrimage whose reward is invoked here
key_terms.لِسَانَهُ: his tongue; restraining harmful or improper speech
key_terms.مِنْ قَابِلٍ: in the coming year or the following year

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for guarding one’s eyes, tongue, and hands during the Days of Tashrīq?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the virtue of self-restraint during the Days of Tashrīq, especially guarding one’s sight, speech, and actions. It promises a great reward from Allah, as if one were granted the reward of a Hajj in the following year.
